# rhythmCI

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/Jayanth-Sreekanth/rhythmCI/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Jayanth-Sreekanth/rhythmCI/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![Lifecycle: stable](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-stable-brightgreen.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#stable)
[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.23476909.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23476909)
<!-- badges: end -->

A toolkit covering complete circadian data analysis workflow primarily for Nanostring nCounter data, encompassing everything from importing and processing to normalization, analysis and visualization. The regression based analysis for estimating the confidence interval of amplitude is broadly applicable, not only for gene-expression data, but also for other biological data. An informative visualization of results accompany the analysis.

## Installation

You can install the development version of rhythmCI from [GitHub](https://github.com/Jayanth-Sreekanth/rhythmCI) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Jayanth-Sreekanth/rhythmCI", build = TRUE)
```
Alternatively, installation can be done with:

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Jayanth-Sreekanth/rhythmCI", build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

## Vignettes and Documentation

For detailed examples and workflows, refer to the vignettes:

```r
# Open the main vignette
vignette("rhythmCI", package="rhythmCI")

```

## Citation

If you use this package in your research, please cite:

> Sreekanth, J., Edel, A., Spies, C., Andreotti, S., & Ananthasubramaniam, B. (2026). rhythmCI: an R package for rhythm detection using harmonic regression amplitude confidence intervals. bioRxiv.
